excerpt:
Rav Eldar addresses several questions in this class, the most prominent of them being about the shebua that Batsheva claims David made to her. The rabbi explains that this was a chance for David to set the tone for his melucha and all of the kingdoms of Yisrael forever after, which is why this story opens up Sefer Melachim.

Recorded on Saturday Feb. 21st, 2015 at 8:45 PM in Congregation Hohma U'Mussar, Brooklyn, NY, 11223.
